android.desc:
Welcome to Workout Quest: Your gamified workout tracker! Gamify your training in a real fitness RPG.

Gamified Gym
Gain experience, level-up muscles, and earn loot, rewards and achievements as you train! Triumph over daily, weekly and monthly quests, and earn loot and coins to buy new cosmetics to customize your avatar and your social calling card!

Revolutionize Your Home and Gym Workouts
Embark on a fitness journey with Workout Quest, where every workout is an opportunity for progress, no matter where you are. Our app makes home workouts convenient and gym workouts efficient by making it quick and easy for you to build your workout on the fly. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete, it's simple to find the exercises you want or new ones that you might not know you needed!

Extensive Workout Library
Our library offers a wide range of workouts, including strength training, cardio, and more. Each exercise comes with clear GIF demonstrations to ensure you're on the right track. Achieve real results with routines that are both effective and enjoyable.

AI-Powered Personalization
As a premium member, you'll benefit from AI-driven workout plans, customized based on your fitness history and goals. Our smart technology adapts to your needs, providing you with the most effective routines using the equipment you have at home. Generate entire workouts with AI, or have the AI recommend exercises to fill in the rest of your workout at the tap of a button. Our AI chat feature allows you to ask any questions you like for AI fitness answers based on your workout history and performance!

AI-Powered Recovery Analysis
Workout Quest allows you to, mid workout, ask questions to AI like "should I drop set this next set" or "should I do incline or flat bench today" to get quick answers personalized on your workout. It also uses AI to analyze your recent workouts and provide an analysis of the fatigue within your body, so you know when you're overworking or underworking different muscles!

Connect and Compete
Workout Quest is more than just an app; it's a community. Connect with friends, share your progress, and take on challenges together. Celebrate your achievements and stay motivated with our supportive network. Keep up to date via the news feed, or see how you stack up against your friends in the leaderboard!

Key Features:
- Gamified Training: Earn experience, level-up muscles, complete quests and achievements, and earn chests and gold to buy

show_hn.title: Show HN: An Android app to gamify exercise tracking

quotes.text:
Hey HN! Over the last few months I've been working on a mobile app written in React Native with a C# backend. The app is supposed to be a simple and minimal exercise tracker with components of gamification and social interaction.

The idea behind creating this was to learn a bit more of the fullstack development flow and pick up some skills regarding product and design (which I thought would be hard, and it turns out it was still much harder than I'd expected haha).

The app is currently only on the Android store due to it being cheaper to license than the Apple store. There are still definitely bugs within the app, however I thought it would be good to get user feedback earlier in the apps life cycle!

Feel free to leave any feedback here or on the play store page. Happy to hear any sort of feedback, thanks for reading and have a good day all :)
